def cache_sim(capacity, ttl, ops):
    from collections import OrderedDict
    
    cache = OrderedDict()  # key -> (value, write_time)
    results = []
    
    for op in ops:
        if op[0] == 'put':
            _, t, key, value = op
            
            # Remove expired entries (check all entries)
            expired_keys = [k for k, (_, write_time) in cache.items() if write_time + ttl <= t]
            for k in expired_keys:
                del cache[k]
            
            # If key already exists, remove it (we'll re-add at end for MRU)
            if key in cache:
                del cache[key]
            
            # If cache is at capacity, evict LRU (first item in OrderedDict)
            if len(cache) >= capacity:
                cache.popitem(last=False)
            
            # Add/update the key as most recently used
            cache[key] = (value, t)
            
        elif op[0] == 'get':
            _, t, key = op
            
            # Remove expired entries
            expired_keys = [k for k, (_, write_time) in cache.items() if write_time + ttl <= t]
            for k in expired_keys:
                del cache[k]
            
            # Check if key exists and get its value
            if key in cache:
                value, write_time = cache[key]
                # Move to end (make MRU)
                del cache[key]
                cache[key] = (value, write_time)
                results.append(value)
            else:
                results.append(-1)
    
    return results
